# Phase Two Specific Execution Plan

1. Re-snapshot competing source hashes after concurrent peer writes settle.
2. Run isolated import/smoke tests against each core candidate.
3. Canonicalize on `apps/shared/movie` if richer-contract tests pass; otherwise revise the decision with evidence.
4. Fully rewrite canonical capabilities to include Animator, Nesher, Video Editor, Mitzvah and motion-graphics personalities.
5. Add small projection-report and structured-intent modules under canonical shared movie.
6. Add or converge adapters without touching unrelated app internals.
7. Extend validator for layer timing, keyframes and exact acceptance safety.
8. Add compatibility translation for millisecond prototype documents only where import tracing proves need.
9. Improve mobile dock with mode, duration, intent controls and an injectable AI callback.
10. Keep each source file under 120 lines, tabs only, full JSDoc and B"H header.
11. Build verification scripts for arbitrary durations, all semantic kinds, all adapters and the 180-second example.
12. Build a browser proof renderer only if no existing renderer can faithfully consume the canonical document.
13. Render actual 180-second media.
14. ffprobe output and sample multiple distant frames.
15. Browser-smoke the mobile dock at a narrow viewport.
16. Full reread and delta ledger; run a second write pass if anything is missing.
17. Final regression and completion gate.
